'''2003 DPC Atlanta''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Atlanta, Georgia (February 2003). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Atlanta, Georgia
* '''Dates:''' February 2003
